statusLine.command: input=$(cat); current_dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); model_name=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); git_branch=$(cd "$current_dir" 2>/dev/null && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); git_status=""; if [ -n "$git_branch" ]; then cd "$current_dir"; if ! git diff-index --quiet HEAD -- 2>/dev/null; then git_status=" *"; fi; ahead=$(git rev-list --count @{upstream}..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0); behind=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..@{upstream} 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$ahead" -gt 0 ] && [ "$behind" -gt 0 ]; then git_status="$git_status ↕$ahead/$behind"; elif [ "$ahead" -gt 0 ]; then git_status="$git_status ↑$ahead"; elif [ "$behind" -gt 0 ]; then git_status="$git_status ↓$behind"; fi; fi; printf "\033[32m    %s\033[0m" "$(basename "$current_dir")"; if [ -n "$git_branch" ]; then printf "\033[36m  %s%s \033[0m" "$git_branch" "$git_status"; fi; printf "\033[35m %s\033[0m" "$model_name"
